title: resolve_data input
description: Which business data is this table, object or file? The build loop's first question: give the location (by its ID, its external ID or its URL) and, when known, the container, and the answer names the domain, its owner, its classification and its rules. Writes nothing.

locationId.description: The location by its row ID.

externalId.description: The location's own ID in its tool, such as an environment ID or a host name.

platformKey.description: Narrows an externalId or url to one platform.

container.description: The container as seen, such as a table, an object or a file. Matched exactly, ignoring case.
